about: Built-in agent CLIs. A user file at <data>/agents.json (or $COLOSSEUM_AGENTS_FILE) can add agents, override any field, set "disabled": true, or list preferred ids under "prefer". argv is run without a shell; {prompt} marks the prompt argument when prompt is "arg", other {name} fields come from "vars". "verified" says whether the invocation was checked against the tool's own documentation; every agent is checked again by `relay.py detect --probe`.

codex.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
codex.doc: codex exec reads the prompt from stdin with -; read-only sandbox

gemini.name: Gemini CLI
gemini.doc: piped stdin runs headless; default approval mode does not auto-run tools

kimi.name: Kimi Code CLI
kimi.doc: kimi -p runs one prompt without the TUI and prints the reply

mcode.name: MiniMax Code
mcode.doc: mcode exec [prompt] is the headless mode

qwen.name: Qwen Code
qwen.doc: Gemini CLI fork; piped stdin runs headless

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.doc: opencode run [message]; stdin is closed because run waits for EOF otherwise. Set family to the model's vendor in the user file

hermes.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
hermes.doc: hermes -z prints only the final reply; dangerous commands still need approval without --yolo

openclaw.name: OpenClaw
openclaw.doc: openclaw agent --agent <id> --message <text> runs one turn through the gateway; the gateway must be running

ollama.name: Ollama (local model)
ollama.doc: needs vars.model in the user file, e.g. {"agents": {"ollama": {"vars": {"model": "qwen3"}}}}

claude.name: Claude Code CLI
claude.doc: same family as the built-in Claude participants, so it is picked only when the user asks for it
